disclosures.text: Cutting tool for arrangement on a cylindrical drive shaft
Cutting tool has a continuous receiving opening for the drive shaft
A central axis runs through the receiving opening
Central axis corresponds to the tool's rotation axis when mounted
Receiving opening is delimited by a peripheral wall
Peripheral wall has at least three contact projections for partial contact with the drive shaft
At least one contact projection has different distances to its two circumferentially adjacent contact projections

A cutting tool for a cylindrical drive shaft with a continuous receiving opening, a central axis corresponding to the rotation axis, a peripheral wall with at least three contact projections, where at least one projection has unequal distan
All distances between adjacent contact projections are of different sizes
Each distance from a first contact projection to any other contact projection is unequal to any distance from a second contact projection to any other contact projection
Largest distance between adjacent contact projections is at least 102% of the smallest distance
Largest distance between adjacent contact projections is at most 170% of the smallest distance
At least three contact projections touch an imaginary circle in the plane of rotation, centered on the central axis
At least one contact projection touches the circle along a circumferential angle range of less than 20°
All contact projections touch an imaginary circle in the plane of rotation, centered on the central axis
Peripheral wall between two adjacent contact projections has a maximum distance to the central axis
At least two maximum distances between adjacent contact projections and the central axis are of different sizes
Center of mass of the cutting tool lies on the central axis
Pockets are formed between the contact projections
Pockets remain free when the cutting tool is mounted
Contact projections and pockets are designed so the center of mass lies on the central axis
Peripheral wall has at most fourteen contact projections
Peripheral wall has at most seven contact projections
